meta.title: Refactor REPL to eliminate temporary file usage
meta.body_summary: Replace temporary file usage in the REPL with in-memory Cursor<Vec<u8>>, eliminating 43 lines of I/O code and improving performance and reliability.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot refactored temporary file usage to Cursor in REPL; maintainer requested removal of duplicate test, which was fixed and merged swiftly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 60 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, low-risk performance refactor and aligns with a fast, frictionless merge.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer requested removal of duplicate basic_test_no_rt redefinition; Copilot removed it in follow-up commit 5a04778.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate temporary file creation in REPL by using in-memory Cursor, improving I/O performance and reliability.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Eliminating temporary files with Cursor is well within Copilot's capability for small Rust refactors; merge friction was low with only a minor cleanup request.

maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer requested removal of duplicate test redefinition; Copilot fixed it in a follow-up commit before merge.

core_change_summary.description: In src/bin/cosh.rs, replaced tempfile/BufReader with std::io::Cursor<Vec<u8>> for REPL input and expression evaluation, eliminating 43 lines of temporary file I/O; also removed a duplicate test function in tests/tests.rs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: 11 lines deleted in tests/tests.rs to remove duplicate basic_test_no_rt redefinition.
